<STRUCT_0001>
Recall that given an algebraic space <MATH_0001> over <MATH_0002> as in
the definition, we already have defined the small <ACCENT_0001>tale sites
<MATH_0003> and <MATH_0004>, see
Properties of Spaces, Section <REF_0001>.
We will silently identify the corresponding topoi using
the inclusion functor <MATH_0005>
(Properties of Spaces, Lemma <REF_0002>)
and we will call it the small <ACCENT_0002>tale topos of <MATH_0006>.
Next, we establish some relationships between the topoi
associated to these sites.
